catalysts.name: F12-ortho-iodo-p-terphenyl axial isomer A
catalysts.axial_identity: Separate isolated atropisomer: in the conventional extended terphenyl drawing both terminal ortho iodine substituents lie on the same side of the long terphenyl axis. Racemic if axial chirality is resolved. The constitution-only SMILES does not encode this relative axial identity.

catalysts.name: F12-ortho-iodo-p-terphenyl axial isomer B
catalysts.axial_identity: Separate isolated atropisomer: in the conventional extended terphenyl drawing terminal ortho iodine substituents lie on opposite sides of the long terphenyl axis. The constitution-only SMILES does not encode this relative axial identity.

conditions.mixing_order: Q and T at -80 °C for 30 min; add catalyst, stir 5 min; add K at -80 °C.
conditions.yield_definition: Measured product yield (%) at each time point. The general 6 h synthetic procedure isolates product. Time-course assay details and replicate errors are not separately stated.
conditions.workup: The general 6 h procedure uses saturated aqueous NaHCO3 (4 mL), ether extraction, brine wash, drying and silica chromatography.

product.name: Methyl 1,2-dihydro-α,α-dimethyl-2-[(2,2,2-trichloroethoxy)carbonyl]-1-isoquinolineacetate
product.stereochemistry: Product constitution specified; no absolute stereochemical assignment is supplied.
product.identity_basis: Structure of the experimentally isolated product; the SMILES is a transcription of that structure.

model_conventions.starting_multiplicity: Supplied neutral closed-shell starting models have singlet labels; these labels are model specifications.
model_conventions.solution_free_energy_reporting: Solution free-energy reports require the raw thermal and standard-state conventions and any conversion to the common 1 M convention.
model_conventions.identity_boundary: A and B are distinct prepared samples. Other supplied SMILES specify constitution without assigning solution populations.
